localChanges: Computer players now ship explorers to islands with land still to see, and Settlers with an escort to found cities on other islands, so they no longer stay on their home continent (closes #211).
Land units no longer climb aboard a ship that's only exploring, and sink with it.

log: chore: require library-diplomacy 0.1.4, whose Vendetta, ShamPeace and holds this uses

A land unit with nothing left to do on its own landmass and a target on another (land to explore, or a city site) becomes a passenger (lib/Unit/overseas): it walks to the player's coastal city nearest the target and waits, embarking when a transport comes alongside. Settlers take an idle defender as escort (StandDown). A transport (Strategies/Unit/Ferry, lib/Unit/ferry) sails alongside a port with passengers waiting, sets off once they're aboard (a lone founder waits up to 3 turns for an escort), and sails to the water beside the target's landmass, where UnloadTransport puts them ashore; it unloads only beside the target's landmass, or anywhere but the cargo's origin. A port where passengers have waited 2 turns builds the cheapest transport when none is free (ferryShipFor), and Settlers count a site overseas as work. Embarking no longer scores for a unit that isn't a passenger, so land units stop boarding the exploring Trireme (civ-clone/web-renderer#211). Nothing new is saved: plans are rebuilt from the survey each turn. civ-clone/web-renderer#211, #374.
